note: The parser reads the next PNG chunk type from attacker-controlled input and begins dispatching on it.
Ancillary text chunks are accepted before IDAT and only marked as present, without being stored or consumed here.
A later metadata query forces the parser to scan the pre-IDAT chunk sequence again through the same stateful path.

The safety obligation is that ancillary parsing must leave the context in a consistent, reusable state before image-size computation; this path violates that obligation after pre-IDAT ancillary handling.
Image decoding reaches the size query and then proceeds with the stale/freed context state, triggering the heap-use-after-free read reported by ASAN.
